selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在每种形态下，你会分别获得3%的某种属性值：

无形态：急速
猎豹形态：爆击
熊形态：全能
枭兽形态：精通
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You gain 3% of a stat while in each form:

No Form: Haste
Cat Form: Critical Strike
Bear Form: Versatility
Moonkin Form: Mastery

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 变为熊形态并发出一声野性咆哮，使15码范围内的所有友方玩家的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shift into Bear Form and let loose a wild roar, increasing the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 60% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你的生命值低于40%时，你会施放狂暴回复，每120秒最多触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you fall below 40% health, you cast Frenzied Regeneration, up to once every 120 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移动速度提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your movement speed by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 变为熊形态并召唤乌索尔之魂，发出震耳的咆哮，使10码范围内的所有敌人瘫痪3秒。伤害可能解除该效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 斜掠、割裂和痛击的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 抵消友方目标身上的腐蚀效果，移除所有诅咒和中毒效果。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你向目标冲锋，发动迎头痛击，打断其正在施放的法术并使其在5秒内无法施放该系法术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You charge and bash the target's skull, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
撕碎、斜掠和迎头痛击可以在任意形态下使用，必要时会使你变形为猎豹形态。

裂伤可以在任意形态下使用，并使你变形为熊形态。

如已习得枭兽形态，愤怒和星火术可以使你变形为枭兽形态。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shred, Rake, and Skull Bash can be used in any form and shift you into Cat Form, if necessary. 

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在德鲁伊博大精深的学识启发下，你在每一种形态下都能获得一项额外加成：

无形态：4%魔法伤害
猎豹形态：4%耐力
熊形态：5%移动速度
枭兽形态：3%范围伤害减免
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在变为熊形态之后的4秒内，你的生命值和护甲提高15%。

此效果每30秒只能触发一次。

When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 树皮术的持续时间延长4秒。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 对主要目标施放的凶猛撕咬伤害提高8%，每个受到你的割裂影响的敌人都会使此效果提升，最多6个敌人。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高5%，且每消耗一个连击点数就将获得2点能量。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的流血伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage of your bleeds increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 凶猛撕咬每消耗一个连击点数，还会对附近所有敌人造成([38.19% of Attack Power])点伤害。凶猛撕咬消耗额外的能量可使造成的伤害最多提高100%。目标超过5个时伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Ferocious Bite also deals (38.19% of Attack Power) damage per combo point spent to all nearby enemies. Spending extra Energy on Ferocious Bite increases damage dealt by up to 100%. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 猛虎之怒使你的急速提高10%，能量回复速度提高25%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tiger's Fury increases your Haste by 10% and Energy recovery rate by 25% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of [Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane / Berserk] by 60 sec.

进入狂暴，持续15秒。在狂暴期间：

每1.5秒产生1个连击点数，生成连击点数的技能额外产生1个连击点数。终结技可返还最多3个超过上限的连击点数。

所有攻击和技能的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Go Berserk for 15 sec. While Berserk:

Generate 1 combo point every 1.5 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate 1 additional combo point. Finishing moves restore up to 3 combo points generated over the cap.

All attack and ability damage is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
凶猛撕咬的伤害提高15%。

每消耗一个连击点数，凶猛撕咬的主要目标受到你的猎豹形态的流血和其他周期性效果的伤害提高6%，持续4秒。

Ferocious Bite deals 15% increased damage.

For each Combo Point spent, Ferocious Bite's primary target takes 6% increased damage from your Cat Form bleed and other periodic abilities for 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
猛虎之怒会使你的下3个终结技恢复1个连击点数。

猛虎之怒还会使你的流血技能的持续性伤害在其整个持续时间内额外提升10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Tiger's Fury causes your next 3 finishing moves to restore 1 combo point.

Tiger's Fury also increases the periodic damage of your bleeds by an additional 10% for their full duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 割裂的伤害有4.0%的几率使你的下一个凶猛撕咬无消耗，并且造成最大伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rip damage has a 4.0% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite free and deal the maximum damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 倾泄出狂暴的怒火，用你的利爪向目标发动5次扫击，造成[([16.3% of Attack Power]) * 5]点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成[5 * ([32.67% of Attack Power]) * 6 / 2]点流血伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unleash a furious frenzy, clawing your target 5 times for [(16.3% of Attack Power) * 5] Physical damage and an additional [5 * (32.67% of Attack Power) * 6 / 2] Bleed damage over 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
召唤灵魂，爆发出能量，在4秒内连续快速引导16 / 乌索克的指引: 12 / 月神的守护: 12 / 星界洞察: 20个德鲁伊法术和技能。 [阿莎曼的指引: 使用强力法术或技能的几率提高。]

你会根据当前的形态对附近合适的目标施放野性成长、迅捷治愈、月火术、愤怒、愈合、回春术、斜掠和痛击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 / Ursoc's Guidance: 12 / Elune's Guidance: 12 / Astral Insight: 20 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec. [Ashamane's Guidance: Chance to use an exceptional spell or ability is increased]

You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 终结技每消耗一个连击点数，便有3%几率使急速提高10%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point spent to grant 10% Haste for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你受到的所有伤害降低50%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces all damage you take by 50% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 割裂伤害提高20%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
潜行时，斜掠还会使目标昏迷4秒，并且期间造成的伤害提高60%。

潜行时，撕碎造成的伤害提高60%，爆击几率加倍，并且额外产生1点连击点数。

While stealthed, Rake will also stun the target for 4 sec, and deal 60% increased damage for its full duration.

While stealthed, Shred deals 60% increased damage, has double the chance to critically strike, and generates 1 additional combo point.

终结技，立即造成伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人施加割裂效果。根据连击点数决定持续时间：

   2点：造成[([15.5% of Attack Power]) * 3]点伤害，割裂效果持续(2 * 3)秒
   3点：造成[([15.5% of Attack Power]) * 4]点伤害，割裂效果持续(2 * 4)秒
   4点：造成[([15.5% of Attack Power]) * 5]点伤害，割裂效果持续(2 * 5)秒
   5点：造成[([15.5% of Attack Power]) * 6]点伤害，割裂效果持续(2 * 6)秒
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Finishing move that deals instant damage and applies Rip to all enemies within 10 yards. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : [(15.5% of Attack Power) * 2] plus Rip for (2 * 2) sec
   2 points: [(15.5% of Attack Power) * 3] plus Rip for (2 * 3) sec
   3 points: [(15.5% of Attack Power) * 4] plus Rip for (2 * 4) sec
   4 points: [(15.5% of Attack Power) * 5] plus Rip for (2 * 5) sec
   5 points: [(15.5% of Attack Power) * 6] plus Rip for (2 * 6) sec

你的产生连击点数的技能的直接伤害提高，比例相当于你的急速的40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.

Your combo point-generating abilities' direct damage is increased by 40% of your Haste.

[Moment of Clarity: Clearcasting can accumulate up to (0u + 1) charges]

1点：[([204.16% of Attack Power]) / 5]点伤害，弧形范围内[([84.46% of Attack Power]) / 5]点伤害
2点：[([204.16% of Attack Power]) * 2 / 5]点伤害，弧形范围内[([84.46% of Attack Power]) * 2 / 5]点伤害
3点：[([204.16% of Attack Power]) * 3 / 5]点伤害，弧形范围内[([84.46% of Attack Power]) * 3 / 5]点伤害
4点：[([204.16% of Attack Power]) * 4 / 5]点伤害，弧形范围内[([84.46% of Attack Power]) * 4 / 5]点伤害
5点：[([204.16% of Attack Power]) * 5 / 5]点伤害，弧形范围内[([84.46% of Attack Power]) * 5 / 5]点伤害

subSpellsEn.name: Ravage
subSpellsEn.description:
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: [(204.16% of Attack Power) / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) / 5] in an arc
2 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 2 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 2 / 5] in an arc
3 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 3 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 3 / 5] in an arc
4 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 4 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 4 / 5] in an arc
5 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 5 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 5 / 5] in an arc

subSpellsEn.name: Ravage
subSpellsEn.description: Slash through your target in a wide arc, dealing (272% of Attack Power) Physical damage to your target and (142.8% of Attack Power) to all other enemies in front of you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性,  守护
猎豹形态下会保留铁鬃和狂暴回复效果。

从熊形态转变为猎豹形态时，你会保留熊形态下80%的护甲和生命加成，持续6秒。

在进入熊形态后的6秒内，你受到伤害的10%会在8秒内转为恢复生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Feral,  Guardian
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

凶猛撕咬和野性难驯的伤害提高10%，原始之怒的直接伤害提高60%。

 守护
重殴和摧折的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Feral
Ferocious Bite and Rampant Ferocity damage increased by 10% and Primal Wrath's direct damage increased by 60%.

 Guardian
Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂暴回复可以在猎豹形态下施放，消耗40点能量。

熊形态可以使你受到的魔法伤害降低6%。

撕碎、 [野蛮挥砍 / 横扫]的伤害提高10%，裂伤的伤害提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and [Brutal Slash / Swipe] damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性
狂暴期间，撕碎和横扫有20%的几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

 守护
狂暴期间，裂伤、痛击和横扫有20%的几率使你的下一次重殴变为毁灭。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
During Berserk, Mangle, Thrash, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Maul become Ravage.

 Feral
During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性
撕碎、横扫和斜掠的伤害提高10%，爆击几率提高5%。



 守护
裂伤的伤害提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。

裂伤为你恢复5%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

Mangle heals you for 5% of maximum health.

 Feral
Shred, Swipe, and Rake damage increased by 10% and their critical strike chance is increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 狂奔怒吼的持续时间延长25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性,  守护
你每次施放[重殴、摧折、裂伤、痛击或横扫 / 消耗能量的攻击]都会使你的恐惧创痕的持续时间延长0.6秒，至多8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Feral,  Guardian
Every [Maul, Raze, Mangle,  Thrash, or Swipe / attack with an Energy cost that] you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的最大能量值和怒气值提高20点。

狂暴回复还会使你的最大生命值提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.

Frenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
守护
你的恐惧创痕使受影响敌人从你的持续流血伤害效果中受到的伤害提高15%。

 野性
你的恐惧创痕使受影响敌人从你的持续流血伤害效果中受到的伤害提高8%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 15%.

 Feral
Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 8%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
守护
毁灭还会施加流血，在6秒内造成([100% of Attack Power])点伤害，同时削弱目标的力量，使其对你造成的伤害降低15%。

恐惧创痕不会受到生死循环影响。

 野性
毁灭还会施加流血，在6秒内造成([50.4% of Attack Power])点伤害，同时削弱目标的力量，使其对你造成的伤害降低4%。

恐惧创痕不会受到生死循环影响。如果再次施加获得猛虎之怒增益的恐惧创痕，则新的恐惧创痕会造成猛虎之怒激活时的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes (100% of Attack Power) damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death. 

 Feral
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes (50.4% of Attack Power) damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 4%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death. If a Dreadful Wound benefiting from Tiger's Fury is re-applied, the new Dreadful Wound deals damage as if Tiger's Fury was active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 掌握猎豹与巨熊双形态的终极野兽形体转换，施展毁灭性的巨熊撕咬与猎豹狂暴突袭。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Masters seamless shapeshifting between bear and cat forms, unleashing devastating Maul attacks and ravaging primal claws.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 倾泄出狂暴的怒火，在你前方的邻近目标间闪烁突袭5次，爪击周围所有敌人，造成([15.5% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成[([31.08% of Attack Power]) * 6 / 2]点流血伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unleash a furious frenzy, flickering to nearby targets in front of you 5 times and clawing all enemies around them for (15.5% of Attack Power) Physical damage and an additional [(31.08% of Attack Power) * 6 / 2] Bleed damage over 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性
你有16%的几率在任何单目标近战技能后追加一次双重爪击，造成([300% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并产生3点能量。

 守护
你有18%的几率在任何单目标近战技能或摧折后追加一次双重爪击，造成([340% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并产生5点怒气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Feral
You have a 16% chance to follow up any single target melee ability with a Twin Claw, dealing (300% of Attack Power) Physical damage and generating 3 Energy.

 Guardian
You have a 18% chance to follow up any single target melee ability or Raze with a Twin Claw, dealing (340% of Attack Power) Physical damage and generating 5 Rage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
守护
你的自动攻击使下一个变为毁灭的几率提高30%。

 野性
你的自动攻击使下一个凶猛撕咬变为毁灭的几率提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next  become Ravage.

 Feral
Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
野性
毁灭会使你的敏捷提高8%，铁鬃赋予的护甲提高20%，持续8秒。

你在进入战斗后的第一次猛虎之怒会使下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

 守护
毁灭会使你的敏捷提高8%，铁鬃赋予的护甲提高20%，持续8秒。

你在进入战斗后的第一次裂伤会使下一次重殴变为毁灭。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Guardian
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.

 Feral
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Tiger's Fury after entering combat makes your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 猛虎之怒使你在接下来2次产生连击点数的攻击后发动一次最大伤害的无形攻击。割裂和无形攻击的伤害提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tiger's Fury causes you to perform an Unseen Attack for maximum damage after your next 2 combo point generating attacks. Rip and Unseen Attack damage increased by 30%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每消耗一个连击点数触发无形攻击，便会使你的伤害提高0%，持续1秒。额外的效果会延长此技能的持续时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unseen Attacks increase your damage done by 0% for 1 sec per combo point spend to trigger it. Additional applications extend this effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你施放凶猛撕咬时，每消耗一个连击点数就有15%的几率闪烁到30码内的一个敌人身边，发动一次无形攻击。如果施放凶猛撕咬时消耗的连击点数少于5点且消耗的能量值为50点，无形攻击的伤害则会降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you Ferocious Bite, you have a 15% chance per combo point spent to flicker to an enemy within 30 yds and deliver an Unseen Attack. Unseen Attack damage is reduced if less than 5 combo points and 50 Energy are spent on Ferocious Bite.

subSpellsCn.name: 隐匿爪伤
subSpellsCn.description: 切割目标，造成([65.7% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成[([46% of Attack Power]) * 6 / 2]点流血伤害。如果重新施加此效果，任何剩余伤害将添加到新的流血效果中。

subSpellsCn.name: 隐秘横扫

subSpellsEn.name: Unseen Slash
subSpellsEn.description: Slash the target, dealing (65.7% of Attack Power) Physical damage and an additional [(46% of Attack Power) * 6 / 2] Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new Bleed.

subSpellsEn.name: Unseen Swipe
subSpellsEn.description: Swipe nearby targets, dealing (188.75% of Attack Power) Physical damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
